scenarios.title: A｜当晚提醒
scenarios.setting: 凌晨一点，室友还在客厅打电话和放音乐。玩家出来提醒。

turns.prompt: 你想请室友降低音量，避免影响休息，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hey, could you keep it down a little? I’m trying to sleep.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, could you keep it down a little? I’m trying to sleep.
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Sorry, but would you mind turning the music down?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, but would you mind turning the music down?
feedback.explanation: “Would you mind + 动词 -ing”礼貌请求对方做事，给对方表达不便的余地。

choices.text: Hey, it’s pretty late. Could you guys be a little quieter?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, it’s pretty late. Could you guys be a little quieter?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Could you lower your voice a bit? I can hear everything from my room.

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you lower your voice a bit? I can hear everything from my room.
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Can you make your voice smaller?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, could you keep it down a little? I’m trying to sleep.
feedback.explanation: 音量小一点用“keep your voice down / lower your voice”，不说“make your voice smaller”。

turns.text: Oh, sorry. I didn’t realize we were being that loud.

turns.prompt: 你想让对方放轻松，表示理解或不介意，会怎么说？

choices.text: No worries. The walls are pretty thin.

feedback.naturalExpression: No worries. The walls are pretty thin.
feedback.explanation: 用简短回应表示不介意或愿意体谅，可以减轻对方的歉意。

choices.text: It’s okay. I just have to get up early tomorrow.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s okay. I just have to get up early tomorrow.
feedback.explanation: “have to”表示有必要或受条件限制必须这样做，可用于核实办理要求。

choices.text: Thanks. I really appreciate it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I really appreciate it.
feedback.explanation: “appreciate it”是简短感谢，“it”指对方刚提供的帮助。

turns.prompt: 你想友好地结束这段交流，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks. Good night.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. Good night.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Appreciate it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Appreciate it.
feedback.explanation: “appreciate it”是简短感谢，“it”指对方刚提供的帮助。

scenarios.title: B｜第二天认真谈
scenarios.setting: 最近室友已经连续几次深夜制造噪音。第二天早上，玩家决定认真谈一下。

turns.prompt: 关于「室友半夜太吵」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Can we talk about the noise at night?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can we talk about the noise at night?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: I wanted to bring up something about last night.

feedback.naturalExpression: I wanted to bring up something about last night.
feedback.explanation: “I wanted to”在提出请求或话题时常用于缓和语气，不一定只指过去的愿望。

choices.text: You’ve been pretty loud late at night a few times recently, and it’s been affecting my sleep.

feedback.naturalExpression: You’ve been pretty loud late at night a few times recently, and it’s been affecting my sleep.
feedback.explanation: “a few”表示少量，后接可数名词复数；比只说“一些”更偏向数量不多。

choices.text: I don’t mind normal noise, but after midnight it’s becoming difficult for me to sleep.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t mind normal noise, but after midnight it’s becoming difficult for me to sleep.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

turns.text: Sorry. I didn’t think I was being that loud.

turns.prompt: 关于「室友半夜太吵」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: I know you’re probably not doing it intentionally, but I can hear almost everything from my room.

feedback.naturalExpression: I know you’re probably not doing it intentionally, but I can hear almost everything from my room.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: The walls are thin, so even normal conversations can sound pretty loud at night.

feedback.naturalExpression: The walls are thin, so even normal conversations can sound pretty loud at night.
feedback.explanation: 解释墙薄导致声音容易传递，让噪音请求有具体原因，而不只归咎于对方。

choices.text: Could we agree on some quiet hours?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could we agree on some quiet hours?
feedback.explanation: “quiet hours”指约定保持安静的时段，能把噪音讨论落在具体规则上。

choices.text: Maybe after eleven we could both use headphones and keep calls quieter.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe after eleven we could both use headphones and keep calls quieter.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

turns.text: Eleven seems a little early. What about midnight?

turns.prompt: 你想商量适合彼此作息的安静时段，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could we do eleven on weekdays and midnight on weekends?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could we do eleven on weekdays and midnight on weekends?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: That could work on weekends, but I have to get up early during the week.

feedback.naturalExpression: That could work on weekends, but I have to get up early during the week.
feedback.explanation: “have to”表示有必要或受条件限制必须这样做，可用于核实办理要求。

choices.text: I’m okay with compromising. I mainly need quiet when I have work the next morning.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m okay with compromising. I mainly need quiet when I have work the next morning.
feedback.explanation: “I’m okay with”表示可以接受某个安排，适合协商中说明自己的接受范围。

turns.text: Okay. Eleven on weekdays sounds fair.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great. Thanks for working this out with me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Thanks for working this out with me.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Perfect. And I’ll follow the same rule too.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. And I’ll follow the same rule too.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

scenarios.title: C｜问题反复发生
scenarios.setting: 两人已经谈过几次，但凌晨两点玩家再次被吵醒。

turns.prompt: 关于「室友半夜太吵」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: We’ve talked about the noise a few times now, and it’s still happening.

feedback.naturalExpression: We’ve talked about the noise a few times now, and it’s still happening.
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

choices.text: I need to bring this up again because I was woken up at two this morning.

feedback.naturalExpression: I need to bring this up again because I was woken up at two this morning.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: I don’t want to keep having the same conversation, but the late-night noise hasn’t improved.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t want to keep having the same conversation, but the late-night noise hasn’t improved.
feedback.explanation: “late-night noise”具体指出深夜的噪音，避免把投诉扩大成对对方全部行为的评价。

choices.text: We agreed on quiet hours, and I need you to actually stick to them.

feedback.naturalExpression: We agreed on quiet hours, and I need you to actually stick to them.
feedback.explanation: “quiet hours”指约定保持安静的时段，能把噪音讨论落在具体规则上。

turns.text: It was just one night. My friends were here.

turns.prompt: 你想指出噪音问题已经反复发生，会怎么说？

choices.text: It hasn’t been just one night. That’s why I’m bringing it up again.

feedback.naturalExpression: It hasn’t been just one night. That’s why I’m bringing it up again.
feedback.explanation: “hasn’t”与过去分词搭配说明截至现在仍未完成的事，方便对方判断当前进度。

choices.text: Having friends over is fine. Keeping me awake until two isn’t.

feedback.naturalExpression: Having friends over is fine. Keeping me awake until two isn’t.
feedback.explanation: “keeping me awake”表示让自己一直无法入睡，说明干扰持续存在。

choices.text: I understand that you had guests, but our agreement still applies when people are over.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand that you had guests, but our agreement still applies when people are over.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: I’m trying to be reasonable, but I need to be able to sleep in my own home.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m trying to be reasonable, but I need to be able to sleep in my own home.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

turns.text: What do you want me to do? Never have anyone over?

turns.prompt: 关于「室友半夜太吵」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: That’s not what I’m asking. I’m asking you to keep the noise down after the time we agreed on.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s not what I’m asking. I’m asking you to keep the noise down after the time we agreed on.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: You can have people over. I just need you to respect the quiet hours.

feedback.naturalExpression: You can have people over. I just need you to respect the quiet hours.
feedback.explanation: “quiet hours”指约定保持安静的时段，能把噪音讨论落在具体规则上。

choices.text: If you want to stay up late with friends, maybe you could go somewhere else after eleven.

feedback.naturalExpression: If you want to stay up late with friends, maybe you could go somewhere else after eleven.
feedback.explanation: 加上条件说明请求或安排的适用范围，让对方可以结合实际限制回应。

choices.text: If this keeps happening, we’re going to need to reconsider whether this living arrangement works for both of us.

feedback.naturalExpression: If this keeps happening, we’re going to need to reconsider whether this living arrangement works for both of us.
feedback.explanation: “reconsider”表示重新考虑，说明现有安排可能需要调整。

turns.text: Okay. I get it. I’ll make sure it doesn’t happen again.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks. I really need you to stick to that this time.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I really need you to stick to that this time.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Okay. I hope we don’t have to keep having this conversation.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I hope we don’t have to keep having this conversation.
feedback.explanation: “I hope”表达希望而非保证，适合祝愿或说明对后续的期待。
